lines.x: It's just document sorting, right? Please, I do this stuff all the time, piece o' cake.
Doctor, come on, check out my new video. You're gonna love it.
Yeah, that's the icon. Mind giving it a click? Oh, and if it's not too much trouble, maybe the one right beside it too? Hehe, thanks a bunch.
Content! Ideas! Memes! My brain's completely blank! I'm gonna lose subs…
I'm just an amateur explorer, you know. I just plan to take a few shots and then come right back, so I won't be gone for long. Besides, nothing beats chilling at home sweet home.
Medical must've put some weird ideas in your head again, right? Ahhh… I admit, I get these little impulses every now and then, but I promise, I'll never cause you any real trouble.

Video editing is totally my specialty! So, Doctor, you want a Rhodes Island promo? Got a plan for me? All righty, lemme take a look. Hmm… Rhodes Island precautions, Nutrition PSAs, fire safety tutorials…What in the terra are these?!

I have a bad feeling; there must be a terrifying Feline lurking nearby. Doctor, stay alert! They'll catch you off-guard, leap out from some shadowy corners, and smack you to the ground with a single swipe. Eh? It won't happen?

Living together with everyone and discovering new things to film—all the good things in life are compounding! Figuring all that out led me to become an operator, so now I can share my happiness with you.
Let me sneak a quick pic. Yeah, just one shot.
'Sup everyone, welcome to the Click Channel! Eh? No filming in the Doctor's office? Fine, I guess…
Let me do the filming next time.
A promotion? Awesome! Doctor, bring it in, let's get a commemorative photo!
Re…lax… Doctor. This happens every time I get excited, but it's nothing to worry about.
'Sup, everyone!
Leave it to me!
Doctor, don't forget to take everything you need.
Let's see what interesting footage I'll get this time.
Over here!
Tell me what to do.
Fly, my drone!
Let's get to work!
Fire!
Move aside!
I see you!
Hey, smile for the camera!
I just got a killer clip! Make sure you come by and check it out after you get back to the landship.
This is awesome! It's basically a ready–made battle record.
I was so caught up in filming that somebody slipped by me.
My lens is shattered…
Time to open my stream studio!
Wah!
Hey Doctor, I got something cool to show you!
Arknights.

Oh! I just got a new idea. Hold on, where's my camera? And anywhere I can set up a tripod? Alright. Doctor, help me test this out. When the fireworks go off, just look out the window. I'll take a picture of your eyes—
Hiii—

Doctor, have you heard of fancams? It's when you mix a whole bunch of clips together. I sometimes catch you commanding when I'm filming battle records. Ta-dah! Doctor's Command Scene High-Energy Beat Fancam in Ultra HD! It's your birthday present!

Doctor! I came to Rhodes Island just to earn some travel money, but there's no way I would ever leave a company that repairs my drones for free! Even with such big Felines running around, I'm not gonna— Ahhhhh! Is that… Blaze?!
